chapter: Town Hall, Vanguard and large works
title: Early compositions of 1943 and having no favorites
summary: Miss Bliss and other early pieces written in California; his favorite is always the next one.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: We were talking about compositions that you mentioned, "Miss Bliss" and some things that were written very early, I think, before you were 20, in 1943.
In California, around '40 -- with (inaudible)? Spaulding Gibbons?
Oh, it just says they were written by Mingus in 1943.
But you were very young in 1943.
Yeah, that's what I said. That's a baby, still. The -- I just wonder if you care to say what your favorite of your own pieces are, and maybe say something about how you happened to write them.
I don't have any favorites. The one I'm doing next is my favorite.
